description: Recorded run setup and summarized results; historical paths identify original artifacts.

excluded.idle-pressure: Setup failed at the inherited descriptor limit.
excluded.idle-pressure-v2: Remote idle probe timed out; no complete result.
excluded.upload-smoke: Three-second smoke measurements; not decision evidence.

record.acceptance: A repeated measurable benefit in the intended dimension (memory/CPU/latency/validated goodput), without a material correctness or performance regression. Compare each change against the preceding retained version.

request_storage.reason: 12 rotated two-host trials: roughly 36% lower RSS at 8192/16384 connections; median matched-rate CPU improves by 6–12%. All sent requests succeeded. ReleaseSafe full suite and Debug 54/54 steps, 90/90 component tests pass.

idle_reclamation.reason: Three full-slot paired trials: 0/128 baseline successes vs 128/128 with reclamation; candidate p99 4.48–6.27 ms. Ordinary-load CPU is neutral. Longer same-binary off/on checks do not reproduce millisecond p99 spikes. Both build modes pass 55/55 steps and 90/90 components.

request_body_streaming.reason: 18 rotated two-host decision trials with identical length+CRC32 work and fixture observations disabled: approximately 88% lower saturated upload RSS, and 75% lower RSS at 200 MiB/s. Both variants fully accept 8 MiB bodies. Paced 8 MiB p99 improves from 44.9 to 30.1 ms in non-overlapping repeat ranges. Throughput is unchanged; large-body CPU per MiB increases 8–9%. Saturated tails are mixed, including worse 64 KiB median p99 and a large 8 MiB outlier. Retained as an opt-in memory/capacity and paced-upload latency improvement.
request_body_streaming.api: .body = .stream with .consume callback; buffered endpoint defaults unchanged
